title: Sunflower Power Punch
description: Four sequential panels of a stylized anime girl with sunflower-themed accessories and black spiky hair performing a rapid forward punch. Yellow petals and impact sparks explode from her fist across the green background.
prompt: A four-panel horizontal sequence showing an anime-style girl with spiky black hair, sunflower hair accessory, and yellow-black punk outfit with mechanical details, throwing a powerful forward punch. Her outfit includes a short skirt, boots, gloves, and a tail. Yellow petals and bright impact sparks fly from her fist. The character is shown in a dynamic wide stance against a solid bright green background, painted in a bold graphic illustration style.
